name.note: Booking: 'The Lavish Haven - Ahangama'; Google: 'The Lavish Haven Hotel And Resort'

description.value: Comfortable Accommodations: family rooms with air-conditioning, balconies and private bathrooms; each room has a work desk, soundproofing and free WiFi. Exceptional Facilities: a sun terrace, lush garden and a year-round outdoor swimming pool, plus a lounge, coffee shop and outdoor play area. Dining: a modern, family-friendly restaurant serving breakfast with local specialities, fresh pastries and Chinese, Indian and Italian dishes. Location: Kabalana Beach is a 2-minute walk; Koggala Airport is 3.1 mi away.

existing_site.notes: No website and no social account found. A 17-room hotel with a restaurant, spa and pool whose entire web presence is OTA listings plus a Google pin — the largest business in this run and the one paying the most commission.

gaps.why: no owner-written prose anywhere; Booking's summary is generated. The copy must be written from the facts in this dossier
nightly rates are live dated OTA inventory, not a published price list
no check-in or check-out times published
no site, no social account — every booking pays an OTA commission
not published, though reviews establish it is new
six of eight quotes are truncated by Booking's 'Read more'
listing exists but TripAdvisor 403s this harvester

contradictions.what: Distance to the beach: Booking says a 2-minute walk, one guest says 3 minutes.
contradictions.resolution: Minor. Use Booking's figure or say 'a few minutes'.

contradictions.what: Room count: a review summary mentions 17 bedrooms; Booking lists 9 distinct room types with some names repeating.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved — do not publish a room count.

contradictions.what: Parking: Booking lists free private parking; a guest review calls the parking area very small and hard with a car.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved — do not promise easy parking.

contradictions.what: House number: Google listing 'No166/1 walhengoda road, Ahangama 80650'; Booking.com JSON-LD '166/2 Welhengoda Road , 80650 Ahangama'.
contradictions.resolution: Site uses the Google listing address verbatim (playbook 0.5.0 §6). Which number is right is a question for the owner in a live run.
